title: RedactionConfig
description: Configuration for privacy-safe redaction of exported objects.

redact_payloads.description: Replace action payloads with a redaction marker.

redact_targets.description: Replace action targets with the replacement text.

redact_final_output.description: Replace final output with the replacement text.

redact_reasons.description: Replace recorded reasons with the replacement text.

replacement.description: Replacement text used for string fields when redacting.
